items.title: Agent JIT Compilation for Latency-Optimizing Web Agent Planning and Scheduling
items.title_zh: 面向延迟优化的 Web 智能体即时编译规划与调度
items.summary: Agent JIT compilation turns task descriptions into executable code that may include LLM calls, tool calls and parallelization, using a planner that validates plans against tool specifications and a scheduler that explores parallelization strategies. Across five applications, JIT-Planner delivered a 10.4x speedup and 28% higher accuracy than Browser-Use.

items.title: DeepWeb-Bench: A Deep Research Benchmark Demanding Massive Cross-Source Evidence and Long-Horizon Derivation
items.title_zh: DeepWeb-Bench：要求海量跨源证据与长程推导的深度研究基准
items.summary: DeepWeb-Bench is a deep research benchmark whose tasks demand massive evidence collection, cross-source reconciliation and long-horizon multi-step derivation, with source-provenance records for every reference answer. Across nine frontier models, retrieval failures caused only 12-14% of errors while derivation and calibration failures accounted for over 70%.

items.title: Qwen3.7-Max: The Agent Frontier
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.7-Max, billed as "The Agent Frontier", with a post listing chatbot, image and video understanding and generation, document processing and tool use. The release drew 721 points and 290 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: CASTLE: Contrastive and Seed-Guided Training for Cold-Start Natural Language Search
items.title_zh: CASTLE：面向冷启动自然语言搜索的对比与种子引导训练
items.summary: CASTLE generates synthetic queries and relevance labels from structured catalog data for Airbnb's natural language search, combining structure-guided prompting with seed queries and contrastive listing pairs derived from booking sessions. It reports a query-distribution KL of 1.01 versus real users, a 9.2x improvement over the best baseline, and 91-93% human agreement with its labels.

items.title: Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems
items.title_zh: 以成功目标为单位的智能体 AI 能耗核算
items.summary: The paper proposes Energy per Successful Goal, dividing total workflow energy including failures and retries by successfully completed goals, plus an Orchestration Overhead Index comparing agentic with linear execution. Across nine task families, including GPU dynamic energy widened the measured overhead range to 0.4x-26.48x, showing that CPU-only measurement understates agentic costs.

items.title: MindLoom: Composing Thought Modes for Frontier-Level Reasoning Data Synthesis
items.title_zh: MindLoom：为前沿级推理数据合成组合思维模式
items.summary: MindLoom decomposes verified solutions into chains of atomic knowledge-reasoning transformations called thought modes, trains a retrieval model to match problem states to compatible modes, and composes new problems by iteratively applying them. Models fine-tuned on its synthesized data outperformed base, distillation and external-data baselines across nine STEM and math benchmarks.

items.title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
items.title_zh: 用技能程序驾驭 LLM 智能体
items.summary: HASP upgrades agent skills into executable Program Functions that fire on failure-prone states to alter the next action or inject corrective context. It reports improvements on web-search, math and coding tasks and drew 34 upvotes on Hugging Face.

items.title: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform
items.title_zh: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform：企业多智能体 IT 运维平台
items.summary: qinshihu/itops-agent-platform is a TypeScript project billed as China's first enterprise multi-agent IT operations platform, using LLMs for automated remediation on Zabbix and Prometheus with Docker deployment. It had 945 stars and 231 forks.
